_comment: The fee a trade pays, which is where the prize comes from.
NOT TYPED IN. Every row below was decoded from the captured fee-config
parser in radar-pumpfun's fees.rs, and a test in that crate --
still equals what that parser reads. The check lives on the Rust side on
purpose: the capture is hex, and decoding it here would be a second copy of
the fee arithmetic in a language that cannot be asked to agree with the
first. The decoder disposes; this file only publishes.
Research 0028 is the note that asked the chain. The venue's help centre
described a ladder nobody had read; the schedule has twenty-five rows keyed
on market capitalisation, and two live swaps paid a row further down than
their pool's cap selects -- that disagreement is 0028's open question and is
creator_bps is the row that matters to a reader: it is the fee that reaches
the vault, and ADR 0013 makes all of it the weekly prize. 30 bps on the
curve, 95 immediately after graduation, then down to 5 at the top.
EVERY NUMBER HERE HAS A DATE ON IT AND IS EXPECTED TO MOVE.
source: Solana mainnet, fee_config seeded with the PumpSwap program id, slot 444505805

curve.note: Before graduation there is one tier and no liquidity providers.
